daemon_port.description: Port number on which the LAM daemon listens for incoming HTTP requests.

daemon_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the daemon to (empty string means bind to all interfaces).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for daemon logging. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file used by the daemon.

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

ldap_servers.description: List of LDAP server URIs to connect to (supports failover).

items.description: LDAP server URI, e.g., ldap://server.example.com or ldaps://secure.example.com.

ldap_basedn.description: Base DN under which user/group entries are stored in LDAP.

ldap_binddn.description: DN to bind as for LDAP searches (empty = anonymous bind).

ldap_bindpw.description: Password for the bind DN. Leave empty if using anonymous or external auth (e.g., SASL/GSSAPI).

ldap_starttls.description: Enable StartTLS to upgrade plain LDAP connections to TLS.

ldap_cacert.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file for verifying LDAP server TLS certificates. Empty disables verification.

db_driver.description: Database backend for LAM daemon. Currently only 'sqlite' is supported.

db_file.description: Path to SQLite database file (used if db_driver = sqlite).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS (SSL/TLS) for incoming daemon connections.

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (required if SSL enabled).

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Time in seconds to cache LDAP results. Set to 0 to disable caching.

request_logging.description: Enable logging of individual requests (URL, method, client IP, response status).

request_log_file.description: Path to the request log file (only used if request_logging is enabled).
